_comment: GC Trait Altar 1:1 (astralsorcery.zs "astral_metal", Aevitas, 3000 starlight -> 4 ingots): starmetal ingot -> raw iron (starmetal = starlight-infused iron ore; AS absent), Illumination Powder -> glowstone dust, Stardust -> nyx meteor shard, meteor ingot + fallen star -> same Nyx items GC used, center Fusion Matrix Ingot -> main ingredient. Forge tier 4: the fusion matrix ingredient already gates this post-draconic (as in GC, where it was a Trait-tier altar craft), so the tier matches the recipe era. RATIO PORT (fixed 2026-07-31): a ritual 'amount' is a COUNT OF PEDESTALS, not a stack size, and the Hephaestus Forge has exactly 8 (RitualManager.PEDESTAL_OFFSETS); Ritual.checkIngredients also requires the filled-pedestal count to equal sum(amounts) exactly. GC's 4x-of-each-into-4-ingots needed 20 pedestals, so it was uncraftable and JEI dropped it (AIOOBE in HephaestusForgeCategory.addInputs). Everything is scaled 1/4 - 1x of each component, 1 ingot out, aureal 120 -> 30 - so the cost per ingot is identical to GC. GC expert mode halved output to 2 per 4x inputs; FA rituals are mode-agnostic data, so the normal/adventure ratio is the one kept.
